title: Chemical hygiene
description: OSHA-required chemical hygiene plan basics: SDS, fume hood operation, hazardous-waste segregation, and labeling. No expiry once passed, but content review encouraged annually.

quizData.question: Where do you find the hazard summary for a new reagent before opening the bottle?
options: Safety Data Sheet (SDS) — section 2 lists hazards

quizData.question: A fume hood sash should be at what height during use?
Which storage pairing is unsafe?
options: Acids and bases together on one shelf
Bases on the lower shelf of a base cabinet

quizData.question: A working solution you prepared must be labeled with…
options: Contents (full chemical name), concentration, date, your name, and any hazard pictogram
Nothing — you know what's in it

quizData.question: Halogenated and non-halogenated organic solvents must be…
options: Kept in separate, labeled waste bottles
